catalysts.headline: Fathom Holdings reported Q3 2026 results: revenue $88.6M, down ~23% YoY from $115.3M in Q3 2025; net loss widened to $21.8M (vs a $6.2M net loss in Q2 2026); agent count fell 51% YoY to 6,801 (from 13,931), which the company attributes partly to a 2026 change in how it counts agents; transactions fell 26% YoY to 8,499; gross commission income fell to $26.6M
catalysts.impact: Steep revenue, transaction, and agent-count declines; net loss nearly tripled quarter-over-quarter
catalysts.note: Company's own primary press release/8-K was not located and could not be independently verified this session; figures are from an AP wire snapshot and a third-party aggregator.

catalysts.headline: Fathom Holdings and Neighborhood Intelligence Inc. (NXH, formerly the Bed Bath & Beyond entity) announced mutual termination of their previously announced merger agreement; Fathom's chairman said 'At current valuations, we do not believe a merger appropriately reflects the fair value of either company'

Fathom Holdings and Neighborhood Intelligence, Inc. (NXH, formerly Bed Bath & Beyond's parent) mutually agreed to terminate their proposed merger agreement entirely. No termination fee is owed by either party. Both boards concluded a deal at prevailing valuations would misprice one or both companies; NXH's chairman/CEO Marcus Lemonis said the decision followed shareholder consultation and a wish to retain NXH's blockchain/digital-asset stakes (including tZERO). Both companies plan to stay independent but continue exploring collaboration, including possible data-sharing.
Fathom executed a Second Omnibus Amendment to its Senior Secured Convertible Promissory Notes
8-K: maturity date of outstanding notes extended from 2026-10-01 to 2026-11-01; conversion price on the notes changed to $0.65/share.

Per the prior (unverified) snapshot on file, a restructured transaction was proposed around this date under which NXH would contribute its tZERO/Medici/GrainChain stakes for at least $130 million in newly issued Fathom shares, with NXH retaining control. This restructured plan was itself abandoned roughly eleven days after being floated, ahead of the full mutual termination on 2026-10-05.

Fathom and Neighborhood Intelligence (NXH) announced a proposed restructured transaction to replace their June 16, 2026 merger agreement: NXH would contribute its ~38.8% stake in tZERO Group, Medici-related fund assets, and a GrainChain investment to Fathom for >=$130 million in newly issued Fathom shares; NXH expected to retain a controlling interest in Fathom post-close.
catalysts.impact: strongly positive (shares jumped in after-hours trading; magnitude disputed)

catalysts.headline: Nasdaq notified Fathom that for 30 consecutive business days the bid price for its common stock closed below the $1.00 minimum, opening a second compliance period (following the brief regain confirmed 2026-07-06). No assurance of regaining or maintaining compliance.

Fathom reported Q2 FY2026 results: revenue $114.6M (down 6% YoY), GAAP net loss of $6.2M ($(0.19)/share) vs. a $3.6M loss a year earlier; H1 2026 loss totaled $14.4M vs. $9.2M in H1 2025; cash fell to $4.5M; management disclosed substantial-doubt going-concern language citing $44.8M in current liabilities, while saying cash, asset-sale proceeds and committed support should cover at least the next twelve months. Agent count fell ~30% YoY to 9,768.
catalysts.note: exact report date approximated from the August 2026 WTOP/AP snapshot; not independently confirmed to the day

catalysts.headline: Q2 2026 results: revenue $114.6M (-6.0% YoY vs $121.4M); GAAP EPS -$0.19 (vs -$0.13 in Q2 2025); net loss $6.2M; transaction volumes down 13-15% YoY; agent count down ~30% due to strategic rationalization

Fathom Holdings entered a Merger Agreement and Plan of Reorganization with Bed Bath & Beyond, Inc. (subsequently renamed Neighborhood Intelligence, Inc.); implied FTHM equity value of ~$53.38 million; exchange ratio of 0.2236 BBBY shares per Fathom share; expected to close in 2H 2026 pending approvals. Replaced by the Sept 24, 2026 restructured transaction above.

Reported Q4 and full-year 2025 results: FY2025 revenue $420.5M (+25% YoY), FY2025 EPS -$0.72 (improved from -$1.07 in FY2024); Q4 2025 EPS -$0.21 (missed -$0.11 estimate), Q4 2025 revenue $90.6M (missed $97.55M estimate); total 2025 transactions up ~15% YoY
